text.Royal Redoubt:
How to Play ==
When you play Royal Redoubt you get a Outpost with a defense of 6. It puts out a Combat of 3. When the ally ability triggers your opponent has to discard a card.

Note: In the digital app, the opponent discards their card at the beginning of their turn. However when playing with physical cards the discard is made immediately.
 Strategy ==
Behind an Outpost with a strength of 6 your other bases and your HQ are quite safe. The Combat Power of the Royal Redoubt isn't that high. The ally ability is where Star Empire is know for. Slinking your deck and your possibilities to strike back.
